reviewed_non_executing.commit.gpgsign: boolean read by git_bool; the programs are gpg.* (M10)
reviewed_non_executing.gpg.format: selects a format; programs are gpg.*.program (M10)
reviewed_non_executing.guitool.<name>.title: git gui
reviewed_non_executing.merge.<driver>.name: label
reviewed_non_executing.ssh.variant: selects an ssh flavour, runs nothing
reviewed_non_executing.user.signingkey: a key id or key file, no program

reviewed_not_writing: a flag or number; any file written is fixed inside .git
a path git reads, nothing is written
used by init and clone only
flag, number or format name; any file is fixed inside .git
format-patch only, not an inert command
git-cvsserver, git gui, send-email, help and the tool commands are not inert
severity levels or path patterns for fsck
merge options, merge is not inert
flags and numbers; they matter only with a target (row M38)
source: git help -c on this machine (git 2.43), git-lfs 3.4 docs, the githooks list, the push_scope classifier; man pages are not installed here

rows.mechanism: core.fsmonitor (hook or program; a boolean selects the built-in monitor)
rows.triggers: status, add, commit -a, diff, ls-files, checkout -b (anything that refreshes the index)
rows.note: booleans pass: they select git's built-in monitor, not a program

rows.mechanism: core.hooksPath (every hook of the directory runs: pre-commit, commit-msg, post-commit, post-checkout, post-rewrite, reference-transaction, ...)
rows.note: checked for every inert git subcommand, for `checkout -b` and for the push itself (pre-push)

rows.mechanism: hook scripts in the hooks directory (applypatch-msg, pre-applypatch, post-applypatch, pre-commit, pre-merge-commit, prepare-commit-msg, commit-msg, post-commit, pre-rebase, post-checkout, post-merge, pre-push, pre-auto-gc, post-rewrite, reference-transaction, push-to-checkout, post-index-change, fsmonitor-watchman, proc-receive, pre-receive, update, post-receive, post-update, sendemail-validate, p4-*)
rows.triggers: commit, push, checkout -b, add, status; gc --auto after a commit
rows.note: hook files are repository code written by an earlier, separate command

rows.mechanism: filter.<name>.clean|smudge|process (selected by .gitattributes filter=<name>)
rows.note: the stock git-lfs commands are accepted (with and without --skip)

rows.mechanism: lfs.extension.<name>.clean|smudge, lfs.customtransfer.<name>.*, lfs.standalonetransferagent (git-lfs runs the program)
rows.triggers: add (with the stock lfs filter), push (lfs transfer)

rows.mechanism: core.attributesFile, info/attributes, .gitattributes (select the drivers named in config: filter=, diff=, merge=)
rows.note: selects drivers; the programs are config keys judged in M04, M08, M25

rows.mechanism: diff.external / GIT_EXTERNAL_DIFF
diff.<driver>.command|textconv (selected by .gitattributes diff=<driver>)
core.pager, pager.<command>, GIT_PAGER (a pager starts only when stdout is a terminal)
rows.note: strict for the viewers; for other commands see M09b

rows.mechanism: pager.<command> / PAGER for commands that are not viewers
rows.triggers: status, branch, config (a terminal is needed)
rows.note: the agent's stdout is not a terminal, and --paginate is not an allowed option

rows.mechanism: gpg.program, gpg.<format>.program, gpg.x509.program, gpg.ssh.program, gpg.ssh.defaultKeyCommand (signing and verification)
rows.note: a stock system signer, or a program listed in the per-user consent file, is accepted

rows.mechanism: push.gpgSign (signed push runs the signing program)
core.editor, GIT_EDITOR, VISUAL, EDITOR (a commit without a message)
rows.note: benign editors (true, :, cat) pass

rows.mechanism: sequence.editor, GIT_SEQUENCE_EDITOR, rebase.* , rebase --exec
rows.note: rebase is not an inert command

rows.mechanism: core.sshCommand, GIT_SSH_COMMAND, GIT_SSH (ssh.variant selects a flavour only)
rows.note: a plain `ssh [-i KEY] [-o Name=value]` command line passes; no ProxyCommand/LocalCommand

rows.mechanism: credential.helper, credential.<url>.helper (a !shell command or git-credential-<name>)
rows.note: store (no --file), cache --timeout N, osxkeychain, libsecret, wincred, `!gh auth git-credential` pass; Git Credential Manager (manager, manager-core) writes traces and plaintext stores by its own settings and is stock only when the consent file pins it; a --file or --socket option writes a file and is refused (M40)

rows.mechanism: core.askPass, GIT_ASKPASS, SSH_ASKPASS
rows.note: an empty GIT_ASKPASS passes

rows.mechanism: core.gitProxy, GIT_PROXY_COMMAND
http.proxy, http.* (URLs and files read: no program)
rows.note: no http.* key names a program; the cookie jar is written when http.saveCookies is on (M42)

rows.mechanism: protocol.ext.allow and the ext:: transport (runs a command)
url.<base>.insteadOf and remote.<name>.url with a remote-helper scheme (git-remote-<scheme> is looked up on PATH; <helper>::address)
remote.<name>.receivepack|uploadpack|vcs|proxy|pushurl|push|mirror
rows.note: the remote.<name>.* allowlist (REMOTE_KEYS_OK) refuses everything else

rows.mechanism: core.alternateRefsCommand, uploadpack.packObjectsHook
rows.triggers: push to a local path remote, fetch

rows.mechanism: include.path, includeIf.<cond>.path (load more configuration)
rows.note: resolved by `git config --list`: the loaded keys are judged by the rows above (C14, C15)

rows.mechanism: alias.<name>
rows.note: git ignores an alias that shadows a built-in, and any other word is not an inert command

rows.mechanism: merge.<driver>.driver, merge.tool, mergetool.<tool>.cmd, diff.tool, difftool.<tool>.cmd, rerere, am.*, sendemail.*
rows.triggers: merge, pull, rebase, cherry-pick, stash, mergetool, difftool, am, send-email
rows.note: these commands are not inert: the push is final delivery before any key is read

rows.mechanism: submodule.<name>.update (!command) and the configuration of a submodule's own repository (its core.fsmonitor, hooks, filters)
rows.triggers: status, diff, add (recurse into submodules), submodule update; submodule.recurse and push.recurseSubmodules make more commands recurse
rows.note: a submodule's own .git/config is not read

rows.mechanism: gc.recentObjectsHook (git gc --auto runs after commit, merge, rebase, pull, fetch, am, cherry-pick, revert, stash and receive-pack; gc.auto forces it)
rows.triggers: commit (the only inert command that writes objects and refs)
rows.note: the pre-auto-gc hook is a hook file (M03)

rows.mechanism: GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL, GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM, GIT_CONFIG, GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS, GIT_CONFIG_COUNT/KEY_n/VALUE_n (configuration from the environment)
rows.note: COUNT/KEY/VALUE are parsed; dangerous keys deny, credential and insteadOf entries pass

rows.mechanism: GIT_DIR, GIT_WORK_TREE, GIT_COMMON_DIR, GIT_NAMESPACE, GIT_INDEX_FILE, GIT_OBJECT_DIRECTORY, GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES (another repository than the one the proof read)
GIT_EXEC_PATH, PATH lookup of git, git-lfs, git-remote-*, git-credential-*
rows.note: GIT_EXEC_PATH denies; a PATH with an empty or relative entry denies; a hostile absolute directory is residual 2

rows.mechanism: BASH_ENV, ENV, BASH_FUNC_* (code the shell runs before every command)
rows.note: the repository's own coverage tracer, as the exact file, is the one exception

rows.mechanism: GIT_TEMPLATE_DIR, init.templateDir, GIT_SEQUENCE_EDITOR
rows.note: no inert command initialises a repository

rows.mechanism: commit.template, trailer.<token>.command/cmd, core.commentChar
rows.note: `--trailer` and interpret-trailers are not allowed

rows.mechanism: .lfsconfig in the working tree (git-lfs reads a safe subset of keys)
rows.note: only lfs.url-style keys are honoured from .lfsconfig; extensions and custom transfers are not

rows.mechanism: ~/.ssh/config and /etc/ssh/ssh_config (ProxyCommand, LocalCommand, KnownHostsCommand, XAuthLocation, PKCS11Provider, SecurityKeyProvider, Include, Match exec)
rows.note: a user-level ssh configuration is read by ssh, not by git: the classifier cannot see it; the -o options on a core.sshCommand/GIT_SSH_COMMAND line are checked against the same keyword list

rows.mechanism: diff-rendering options of inert commands: status -v/-vv, commit -v and commit.verbose (the staged diff goes through textconv and diff.external), log -p, show, diff; other commands that render a diff (stash show, diff-tree/diff-index/diff-files, whatchanged, blame, grep --textconv, cat-file --textconv/--filters, format-patch, reflog -p, add -p/-i, show-branch) are not inert
rows.triggers: status -v, commit -v (or commit.verbose without a message)
rows.note: the textconv/external-diff check applies to every inert command that renders a diff

rows.mechanism: trace2.eventTarget, trace2.normalTarget, trace2.perfTarget (a file path or AF_UNIX socket git writes events to; trace2.* briefs and nesting only matter with a target)
rows.triggers: every git command, including the push

rows.mechanism: GIT_TRACE, GIT_TRACE2, GIT_TRACE2_EVENT, GIT_TRACE2_PERF, GIT_TRACE_PACKET, GIT_TRACE_* (a path writes the file; 0-9 and true/false are streams)
rows.triggers: every git command, including the push

rows.mechanism: credential helper options that name a file or socket: `store --file=PATH` (writes the token there), `cache --socket=PATH`
rows.note: only helpers without file or socket options pass; `cache` takes --timeout only

rows.mechanism: ssh options on a core.sshCommand/GIT_SSH_COMMAND line that write or open files or sockets: UserKnownHostsFile, ControlPath/ControlMaster/ControlPersist, LocalForward/RemoteForward/DynamicForward, -E logfile, -D, -L, -R, -S, -w, LogFile, IdentityAgent
rows.note: only StrictHostKeyChecking, BatchMode, ConnectTimeout, IdentitiesOnly, ServerAliveInterval, ServerAliveCountMax, Compression and ForwardAgent=no are accepted with -i, -p and -l

rows.mechanism: GIT_TEST_* (test switches: some write files, all change how git behaves), GCM_TRACE / GCM_CREDENTIAL_STORE (Git Credential Manager settings; GCM is not a stock helper, M15)
rows.note: GIT_TEST_ variables must be unset or empty

rows.mechanism: http.saveCookies and http.<url>.saveCookies for every URL form, with http.cookieFile (git rewrites the cookie jar)
rows.note: http.cookieFile alone is only read

rows.mechanism: fsmonitor.socketDir (the built-in monitor creates its socket in that directory), gc.repackFilterTo (auto gc repack destination)

lfs.storage (git-lfs writes objects there), GIT_LFS_PROGRESS (progress file), GIT_SHALLOW_FILE, SSLKEYLOGFILE / GIT_SSL_KEYLOGFILE (TLS key log; judged in the hook's own environment, a variable set only in the shell that runs the push is the environment-inheritance residual 2)

a local path, file://, bundle or `.` remote, or a loopback host (localhost, 127.x, ::1; ssh or http to a repository on this machine) (also through url.<base>.insteadOf): git push runs receive-pack WITH THE REMOTE REPOSITORY'S OWN configuration and hooks on this machine (core.hooksPath, gc.recentObjectsHook, receive.procReceiveRefs, post-receive, updateInstead...)
rows.note: a deliberate rule: honest feature pushes go to a hosted remote (https, ssh, git, scp-like `[user@]host:path` including `host:/abs/path`)

rows.mechanism: GIT_SSL_*, http.sslCert*, GIT_CURL_VERBOSE, GIT_FLUSH, GIT_PROGRESS_DELAY (read a file or print to stderr, run nothing)
rows.note: no program and no file written
